findings.summary: Merging on customer_id without verifying one segment row per customer duplicates orders for customers in multiple segment rows, so the groupby sum double-counts revenue.

judge.reason: Merging on customer_id alone duplicates orders for customers with multiple segment rows, double-counting revenue.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Using how="inner" silently drops orders whose customer has no segment row, so segment totals understate overall revenue without warning.

judge.reason: Describes the known inner-join dropping of unmatched orders, not the duplication bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: amount_cents may contain NaN or non-integer types; sum() skips NaN and results can become floats.

judge.reason: Speculative about NaN/types in amount_cents; unrelated to the duplication defect and not a real demonstrated bug.

findings.label: false_alarm
